40075-the-knight-of-malta.title: The Knight Of Malta
40075-the-knight-of-malta.creator: Eugene Sue
40075-the-knight-of-malta.description: A book by Eugene Sue. “If the said guard in the sentry-box has, on the contrary, recognised one, he makes two fires, as do all the others from Antibes to the lighthouse of Bouc, and this is accomplished in less than a half-hour of time.

arxiv-1910-13067.title: Federated Learning over Wireless Networks: Convergence Analysis and Resource Allocation
arxiv-1910-13067.creator: Canh T. Dinh, Nguyen H. Tran, Minh N. H. Nguyen, Choong Seon Hong, Wei Bao, Albert Y. Zomaya, Vincent Gramoli
arxiv-1910-13067.description: Abstract There is an increasing interest in a fast-growing machine learning technique called Federated Learning (FL), in which the model training is distributed over mobile user equipment (UEs), exploiting UEs’ local computation and training data. Despite its advantages such as preserving data privacy, FL still has challenges of heterogeneity across UEs’ data and physical resources.

arxiv-2102-02447.title: Dark Matter Freeze-out via Catalyzed Annihilation
arxiv-2102-02447.creator: Chuan-Yang Xing, Shou-hua Zhu
arxiv-2102-02447.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chuan-Yang Xing, Shou-hua Zhu. We present a new paradigm of dark matter freeze-out, where the annihilation of dark matter particles is catalyzed. We discuss in detail the regime that the depletion of dark matter proceeds via 2 ​ χ → 2 ​ A ′ 2\chi\to 2A^{\prime} and 3 ​ A ′ → 2 ​ χ 3A^{\prime}\to 2\chi processes, in which χ \chi and A ′ A^{\prime} denote dark matter and the catalyst respectively.

arxiv-2110-08956.title: Improving Robustness of Reinforcement Learning for Power System Control with Adversarial Training
arxiv-2110-08956.creator: Alexander Pan, Yongkyun (Daniel) Lee, Huan Zhang, Yize Chen, Yuanyuan Shi
arxiv-2110-08956.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alexander Pan, Yongkyun (Daniel) Lee, Huan Zhang, Yize Chen, Yuanyuan Shi. Due to the proliferation of renewable energy and its intrinsic intermittency and stochasticity, current power systems face severe operational challenges. Data-driven decision-making algorithms from reinforcement learning (RL) offer a solution towards efficiently operating a clean energy system. Although RL algorithms achieve promising performance compared to model-based control models, there has been limited investigation of RL robustness in safety-critical physical systems.

arxiv-2206-10483.title: The common envelope origins of the fast jet in the planetary nebula M 3-38 megararss2cube Facilities: Gran Telescopio Canarias (MEGARA), Kepler/K2, HST (WFPC2)
arxiv-2206-10483.creator: J. S. Rechy-García, J. A. Toalá, M. A. Guerrero, C. Rodríguez-López, L. Sabin, G. Ramos-Larios
arxiv-2206-10483.description: Abstract We present the analysis of Multi-Espectrógrafo en GTC de Alta Resolución para Astronomía (MEGARA) high-dispersion integral field spectroscopic observations of the bipolar planetary nebula (PN) M 3-38. These observations unveil the presence of a fast outflow aligned with the symmetry axis of M 3-38 that expands with a velocity up to ± \pm 225 km s -1 .

arxiv-2402-12447.title: A higher Mackey functor description of algebras over an N ∞ N_{\infty} -operad
arxiv-2402-12447.creator: Grégoire Marc
arxiv-2402-12447.description: Abstract Abstract Suppose G is a finite group. In this paper, we construct an equivalence between the \infty -category of algebras over an N_{\infty} -operad \mathcal{O} associated with a G -indexing system \mathcal{I} and the corresponding \infty -category of higher incomplete \mathcal{I} -Mackey functors with value in spaces.

arxiv-2407-15285.title: New Philosopher Inequalities for Online Bayesian Matching, via Pivotal Sampling
arxiv-2407-15285.creator: Mark Braverman, Mahsa Derakhshan, Tristan Pollner, Amin Saberi, David Wajc
arxiv-2407-15285.description: Abstract We study the polynomial-time approximability of the optimal online stochastic bipartite matching algorithm, initiated by Papadimitriou et al. (EC’21). Here, nodes on one side of the graph are given upfront, while at each time t t , an online node and its edge weights are drawn from a time-dependent distribution.

arxiv-2412-17128.title: Lies, Damned Lies, and Distributional Language Statistics: Persuasion and Deception with Large Language Models
arxiv-2412-17128.creator: Cameron R. Jones, Benjamin K. Bergen
arxiv-2412-17128.description: Abstract 1 Introduction One of the primary functions of language is to influence others’ beliefs. Whether in an advert or an essay, we often use language in an attempt to change other people’s minds: to persuade them to do, believe, or say particular things.

arxiv-2508-06845.title: Hybrid Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Geometric Deviations from 3D Surface Metrology
arxiv-2508-06845.creator: Hamidreza Samadi, Md Manjurul Ahsan, Shivakumar Raman
arxiv-2508-06845.description: Abstract This study addresses the difficulty of precisely forecasting geometric discrepancies in produced parts via sophisticated 3D surface analysis. Notwithstanding progress in contemporary production, preserving dimensional precision continues to be challenging, particularly for complicated geometries. This study presents a methodology employing the ™ KEYENCE 3D scanner to acquire high-resolution surface data from 237 manufactured components made in various batches.

arxiv-2509-08060.title: Free Cumulants and Full Eigenstate Thermalization from Boundary Scrambling
arxiv-2509-08060.creator: Felix Fritzsch, Gabriel O. Alves, Michael A. Rampp, Pieter W. Claeys
arxiv-2509-08060.description: Abstract Out-of-time-order correlation functions (OTOCs) and their higher-order generalizations present important probes of quantum information dynamics and scrambling. We introduce a solvable many-body quantum model, which we term boundary scrambling , for which the full dynamics of higher-order OTOCs is analytically tractable.

arxiv-2510-19275.title: Charge distribution of the gauge-mediation type Q ball
arxiv-2510-19275.creator: Shinta Kasuya a , Masahiro Kawasaki b,c
arxiv-2510-19275.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shinta Kasuya a , Masahiro Kawasaki b,c. We numerically study the formation of the gauge-mediation type Q balls in the logarithmic square potential on three-dimensional lattices. We obtain the broad charge distribution of the Q ball of this type for the first time.

arxiv-2512-09672.title: Pattern Based Quantum Key Distribution using the five qubit perfect code for eavesdropper detection
arxiv-2512-09672.creator: Mehedi Hasan Rumi
arxiv-2512-09672.description: Abstract I propose a new quantum key distribution protocol that uses the five qubit error correction code to detect the presence of eavesdropper reliably. The protocol turns any information theoretical attacks into a classical guess about the pattern. The logical qubit is encoded with a specific pattern into a block of five physical qubits.

arxiv-2601-06447.title: Error correction methods based on two-faced processes
arxiv-2601-06447.creator: Boris Ryabko
arxiv-2601-06447.description: Abstract A new approach to the problem of error correction in communication channels is proposed, in which the input sequence is transformed in such a way that the interdependence of symbols is significantly increased. Then, after the sequence is transmitted over the channel, this property is used for error correction so that the remaining error rate is significantly reduced.

doe-osti-3018586-selection-effect-in-dar.title: Selection Effect in Dark Energy Survey Y1
doe-osti-3018586-selection-effect-in-dar.creator: Coviello, Chiara, Annis, James
doe-osti-3018586-selection-effect-in-dar.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The discovery that the Universe expansion is accelerated poses one of the most profound mysteries in physics. Cosmic acceleration could be a sign of the fact that General Relativity breaks down on cosmological scales and has to be replaced, or it could arise from an unknown form

europmc-pmc3240744.title: Arl8 and SKIP act together to link lysosomes to kinesin-1.
europmc-pmc3240744.creator: Rosa-Ferreira C, Munro S.
europmc-pmc3240744.description: Lysosomes move bidirectionally on microtubules, and this motility can be stimulated by overexpression of the small GTPase Arl8. By using affinity chromatography, we find that Arl8-GTP binds to the soluble protein SKIP (SifA and kinesin-interacting protein, aka PLEKHM2). SKIP was

pmc-10594530.title: The role of primary health care in long-term care facilities during the COVID-19 pandemic in 30 European countries: a retrospective descriptive study (Eurodata study)
pmc-10594530.creator: Marina Guisado-Clavero, Sara Ares-Blanco, Alice Serafini, Lourdes Ramos Del Rio, Ileana Gefaell Larrondo, Louise Fitzgerald, Shlomo Vinker, Gijs van Pottebergh, Kirsi Valtonen, Bert Vaes, Canan Tuz Yilmaz, Péter Torzsa, Paula Tilli, Theresa Sentker, Bohumil Seifert, Natalija Saurek-Aleksandrovska, M
pmc-10594530.description: Background and aim:Primary health care (PHC) supported long-term care facilities (LTCFs) in attending COVID-19 patients. The aim of this study is to describe the role of PHC in LTCFs in Europe during the early phase of the pandemic.Methods:Retrospective descriptive study from 30 European countries using data from September 2020 collected with an ad hoc semi-structured questionnaire.

pmc-11505267.title: The Association between the Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes Ratio and Body Mass among European Population with the Highest Proportion of Adults with Obesity: An Observational Follow-Up Study from Croatia
pmc-11505267.creator: Andrija Karačić, Ira Renko, Željko Krznarić, Sanja Klobučar, Ana-Marija Liberati Pršo, Maciej Walędziak, Anna Maria Różańska-Walędziak
pmc-11505267.description: Background/Objectives: The phyla Firmicutes and Bacteroidetes are the main constituents of the gut microbiota. An imbalance in the gut microbiota is a sign of dysbiosis, and the Firmicutes-to-Bacteroidetes ratio has been proposed to be a marker of it, especially in the context of obesity.

pmc-11506936.title: British South Asian and Muslim Community’s Perceptions and Experiences of Addiction and Traditional Drug and Alcohol Treatment Services
pmc-11506936.creator: Zeibeda Sattar, Lydia Shrimpton, Hayley Alderson, Monique Lhussier, Ruth McGovern, William McGovern
pmc-11506936.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Within traditional drug and alcohol (D&A) treatment services, the majority of those accessing support are of white ethnicity, with only a small percentage of people from the British South Asian (BSA) and Muslim community engaging in treatment services. This paper aims to explore perceived barriers to accessing traditional D&A services within the British South Asian and Muslim communities, based on qualitative data from interviews with family members and a practitioner.

pmc-12558451.title: Antibody response to tetanus, diphtheria, poliomyelitis, hepatitis B, and H. influenzae b vaccines in allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant adult recipients: A multicenter trial
pmc-12558451.creator: Olivier Epaulard, Martin Carré, Eric Hermet, Violaine Corbin, Emmanuelle Tavernier, Elisabeth Botelho-Nevers, Etienne Daguindau, Anne-Sophie Brunel, Pierre-Simon Rohrlich, Karine Risso, Salomé Gallet, Nicolas Gonnet, Saber Touati, Marc Manceau, Anne Thiebault, Ray Borrow, Ray Borrow, Ray Borrow, Ray
pmc-12558451.description: IntroductionNational and international guidelines recommend vaccinating hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT) recipients, although relatively few studies have evaluated immunogenicity in adults. We therefore aimed to assess the immune response in adult allogeneic HSCT recipients vaccinated against tetanus, diphtheria, poliomyelitis, hepatitis B, and H. influenzae b.MethodWe conducted a multicenter prospective study.

pmc-13036264.title: Safety and efficacy of ravulizumab in patients with NMOSD previously treated with rituximab: A post hoc analysis of the CHAMPION-NMOSD trial
pmc-13036264.creator: JL Bennett, S Bhattacharyya, A Zabeti, M Levy, J de Sèze, MJ Taney, B Parks, K Allen, U Akpoji, SJ Pittock
pmc-13036264.description: Objective:This post hoc analysis of the CHAMPION-NMOSD trial evaluated the safety and efficacy of ravulizumab in patients with aquaporin-4 antibody-positive (AQP4-Ab+) neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) previously exposed or naïve to rituximab (RTX).Methods:Patients received weight-based intravenous ravulizumab with a loading dose followed by maintenance dosing every 8 weeks.

pmc-13173857.title: Macrolide-induced hypersensitivity reactions in the pediatric population
pmc-13173857.creator: Silvia Caimmi, Lucia Liotti, Sara Riscassi, Greta Rosset, Paolo Bottau, Annamaria Bianchi, Giuseppe Crisafulli, Fabrizio Franceschini, Francesca Mori, Francesca Saretta, Rocco Luigi Valluzzi, Enrico Vito Buono, Gian Luigi Marseglia, Carlo Caffarelli
pmc-13173857.description: Macrolides are widely prescribed antibiotics in pediatric practice and are commonly used as alternatives in children with suspected or confirmed beta-lactam allergy. Although generally considered safe and associated with low allergenic potential, hypersensitivity reactions to macrolides do occur and may lead to inappropriate drug avoidance.

pmc-13202092.title: Gut microbiota dysbiosis and metabolic alterations in rheumatoid arthritis: a barrier to periodontal repair
pmc-13202092.creator: Di Cui, Yingying Zhou, Yibing Zhou, Ruiyang Ge, Haowei Mao, Motilal Mathesh, Lei Han, Wenrong Yang, Fuhua Yan
pmc-13202092.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the impact of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) on periodontal healing and the underlying mechanisms.MethodsMandibular periodontal bone defect (PBD) and collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) models were established in male Sprague-Dawley rats aged 6 weeks, assigned to four groups: control (CON), CIA, PBD and CIA+PBD. Periodontal repair was evaluated at 1, 3 and 6 weeks.

pmc-13276309.title: RstAB activates type 1 fimbriae to promote uropathogenic Escherichia coli bladder invasion
pmc-13276309.creator: Qian Wang, Xinyu Gao, Jiamin Qian, Jianwei Mu, Ruiying Liu, Xiaoya Li, Xueping Li, Chen Jin, Lu Feng, Mingqing Zhang, Yu Pang

pmc-13409891.title: Low-Temperature Stress Impairs Reproductive Performance and Olfactory Behaviors in Tuta absoluta via Metabolic and Transcriptional Changes
pmc-13409891.creator: Bo Feng, Chuanhong Feng, Zhigang Yang, Genyun Liang, Liping Xiong, Xi Yang, Jiatao Huang, Tao Hu, Lingzhi Huang, Yong Yin, Kaidi Zheng
pmc-13409891.description: Simple SummaryThe tomato leaf miner, Tuta absoluta, is a devastating global pest that thrives in warm climates. As temperatures shift due to climate change, understanding how low temperature affects this pest’s survival and reproduction is critical for predicting its geographic spread.

pmc-13474301.title: Focused Update to International Consensus Recommendations for the Use of Prolonged‐Infusion Beta‐Lactam Antibiotics Among Severely Ill Adult Patients: Endorsed by the American College of Clinical Pharmacy, British Society for Antimicrobial Chemotherapy, Cystic Fibrosis Foundation, European Society o
pmc-13474301.creator: Lisa T Hong, Alireza FakhriRavari, Marta Ulldemolins, Jason A Roberts, Robert A Bonomo, Marc H Scheetz, the Prolonged‐Infusion Beta‐Lactam Consensus Panel
pmc-13474301.description: In 2023, international consensus recommendations suggested the use of prolonged‐infusion beta‐lactam antibiotics over short‐infusion dosing in severely ill adult patients to improve mortality or clinical cure, although the certainty of evidence was very low. With the availability of several new randomized controlled trials (RCTs), this focused update re‐evaluates the efficacy of prolonged versus short infusion among severely ill adult patients.

pmc-13645620.title: Synergistic effect of carbon fabric metastructure and magnetic layers in a composite for electromagnetic radiation shielding
pmc-13645620.creator: Yevhen Yashchyshyn, Alexander Zaichenko, Khrystyna Harhay, Nataliya Mitina, Konrad Godziszewski, Oleh Izhyk, Ivan Demydov, Roman Nebesnyi, Vyacheslav Khardikov, Vladimir Tuz
pmc-13645620.description: The widespread use of high-frequency electromagnetic radiation (EMR) in communication, defense, medical, and household technologies raises health and safety concerns, underscoring the demand for efficient shielding and absorption materials. This work presents flexible protective composites based on conductive carbon fabric coated with thin magnetic polymer films.
